scanner_transformation_vectors.descriptor: The live coordinated input submits ' 00012345 ' (leading and trailing space) unchanged; it must not apply use-scanner.ts raw.trim().
A one-character scan '0' is submitted; the legacy minChars 3 rule must not apply.
A second physical scan arrives while the first attempt is SENDING or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (input gate closed; SAFE.3 coordinator.ts:101-104 and 114-120).
The first attempt is terminal; the operator explicitly confirms a new physical action and scans the identical barcode.
Characters received while the input gate is closed are discarded and never form part of a later submission.
Hardware wedge / camera / manual paths must deliver U+001D unchanged for GS1 element strings; behavior per device is UNKNOWN.

epoch_transition_model.status: OWNER-SELECTED PRINCIPLE; NUMERIC THRESHOLDS UNRESOLVED (O-6, EP-1); proof obligations, not established guarantees

does_not_advance: RESTORE_RELEASE (other than its SAFE.4 resolution fence)

properties.P1_safety: every advances_and_leaves_no_claim transition remains permitted while expected_epoch <= MAX-1; claim creation requires headroom so a claim created after the headroom rule is enforced exists only at epoch <= MAX-1. Not assumed for existing or restored data: current code permits ACQUIRE from MAX-1 to MAX.
properties.P2_liveness: phase-aware reserve plus the supervised-cancellation exit; at MAX with no held claim (checked under the order lock) the does_not_advance exits remain available; no finite reserve guarantees completion through unbounded recovery

epoch_transition_model.held_claim_at_MAX: Pre-existing or restored claims at MAX are blocked by the exhausted-claim gate: every guarded mutation refused, no fence, operations at MAX stay UNKNOWN, supervised escalation required; recovery only by a separately approved policy (EP-2, RC-1). No reset, wraparound, widening or arbitrary advance.
